statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-54297 is an uncontrolled-recursion DoS in Faraday's nested query-string decoding (Faraday::Utils.parse_nested_query / NestedParamsEncoder dehash). fluentd uses faraday only as an outbound HTTP client to operator-configured destinations: log records are sent in request bodies and the destination URL is fixed configuration, so the vulnerable decode path is never invoked with attacker-controlled input. No fixed 1.x release exists (the fix is faraday 2.14.3 only) and the elasticsearch7/azureblob flavors hard-pin faraday 1.x for plugin compatibility; elasticsearch8 already ships 2.14.3.
